items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: All the great black entertainers of that era, Roland Hayes, [Unintelligible}, Marion Anderson, they were all there... It‟s the man from New York... I‟ll never forget it because it was first time to play in anything like that with Roland Hayes there and all these people.

ctx.x: The whole Cleff Club. Were they well known in Chicago?

Yeah, they were well known. Will Marion Cook was, and Huey Blake, they were well known. I‟ll tell you the instance when I ran into them. 1933, the Chicago World‟s Fair in Chicago and on June 19th, celebrate June [unintelligible], they had National Negro Night for the Chicago World‟s Fair, 19333 at Soldier‟s Field. All the great black entertainers of that era, Roland Hayes, [Unintelligible}, Marion Anderson, they were all there and they got this… need a symphony orchestra. Now I‟m studying bass now, I‟ve got…
